headline: Vital Chemtech appoints Bhavik Shirish Pandit as independent director
summary: Vital Chemtech Limited announced the appointment of Mr. Bhavik Shirish Pandit as a Non-Executive Independent Director, effective November 3, 2026. This governance change adds an independent voice to the company's board of directors. For Indian retail investors, board composition updates are routine corporate governance filings that carry minimal immediate financial impact.
why_it_matters: Routine board appointment with no immediate financial consequence for shareholders

headline: Vital Chemtech appoints Mukeshkumar Kanazariya as independent director
summary: Vital Chemtech Limited has announced the appointment of Mr. Mukeshkumar Kanazariya as a Non-Executive Independent Director, effective November 3, 2026. This corporate governance update fulfills standard board composition requirements for the listed specialty chemical entity. Retail investors should note this routine leadership update as part of the company's administrative disclosures.
why_it_matters: Routine board filing with no immediate financial impact.
